how.title: How we work
how.intro: Tell us what you want to source, import or export. We will review what the order involves and agree the terms with you.

steps.d: Tell us what you need, including the quantity and destination if you know them.
We review sourcing options, the route and the documents the order will need.
We agree the goods, price, timing and delivery terms with you.
We coordinate transport and prepare the documents agreed for the shipment.
We coordinate handover at the agreed destination.

how.terms: We confirm who handles freight, customs clearance and delivery for each order before it is dispatched.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Questions about working with Asperlos on sourcing, imports and exports.

items.a: We work with businesses to source, import and export goods. The order determines which documents, transport and delivery arrangements are needed.

items.q: Can I enquire about goods outside the catalogue?
items.a: Yes. The catalogue shows examples, including pulses and dried fruit. Tell us what goods you need, the quantity and the destination if known.
Asperlos is based in Tehran, Iran.
The price depends on the goods, quantity, route and delivery terms. Send the details through the inquiry form or contact us directly.
The documents depend on the goods and route. We identify the documents needed for each order before shipment.
We agree who will handle clearance before dispatch, based on the route and delivery terms.

items.q: How are the goods and delivery terms agreed?
items.a: We confirm the specifications, quantity, timing and delivery terms with you before dispatch.

items.q: How do I request a quote?
items.a: Leave your name and at least one contact detail, an email address or WhatsApp number, in the inquiry form. You can select a catalogue item or describe your request in the message.
